name: data_insight
title: 多 Agent 经营数据诊断

inputs.question: 2026 年前三季度各区域营收结构如何？哪些区域/品类存在结构性异常？给出 3 条可执行的经营建议。

nodes.task: 请探查数据集 {dataset} 的结构与质量。业务问题背景：{question}

tool_args.query: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(revenue),2) AS rev, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY rev DESC
SELECT region, product, ROUND(SUM(revenue),2) AS rev, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(revenue)/COUNT(*),2) AS avg_rev FROM sales GROUP BY region, product ORDER BY region, rev DESC
